title: Warm-up boundary: the first full window may already signal (mean reversion)
purpose: Unlike the crossover, mean reversion has no silent baseline: if the very first full window meets an entry threshold it signals.

provenance.derived_by: by hand, from the strategy document and the fixture bars; not copied from any run of the tool
derivation: closes 10 10 10 10 10 100; lookback 6, entry 2: bars 1-5 warm up (fill 1..5)
bar 6: window 10 10 10 10 10 100, mean 25, variance (5*15^2 + 75^2)/6 = 1125, z = 75/sqrt(1125) = sqrt(5) = 2.236 >= 2: Sell on the first full window (event_index 5)

irrational_double.why: irrational value, rounded to 17 significant digits; the C++ computes it in IEEE double (about 1e-16 relative), so a few ulps of a value below 40 is about 1e-14. 1e-12 leaves two orders of margin and is far below any difference that could change a decision here
